title: CogniLife: Continuous Cognitive Distillation for Deployed Multi-Expert Agent Marketplaces
title_zh: CogniLife：面向已部署多专家智能体市场的持续认知蒸馏

paragraphs.en: CogniLife提出面向多专家智能体市场的持续认知蒸馏设计，通过创作者画像与专家日志缓解冷启动专家问题。 Multi-expert agent marketplaces -- where creators publish domain-specific AI experts for end users to consult -- are an emerging deployment pattern for language technology. A published expert can receive many requests yet little evidence about its creator, who remains active elsewhere: the cold-expert problem. We frame continuous cognitive distillation as converting attributed creator observations into revisable decision rules, communication patterns, and domain procedures. CogniLife proposes a cross-expert attribution design for this problem, with Creator Profiles for transferable creator patterns and Expert Journals for listing-specific knowledge; this design is not yet implemented or evaluated. A deployed platform partially realizes the surrounding lifecycle through creator-authorized authoring, capability-owned proposal filtering, and reversible consolidation of eligible owner-scoped memory. On ProfyBench-v1, an 85-task offline benchmark built from replay seeds and controlled internal tests, the Profy Full configuration as a whole achieves a mean overall score of 4.65/5 from the primary LLM judge, compared with 4.01 for Raw LLM and 4.28 for Expert Prompt, with the largest gains in completeness, specificity, and missing-information tasks. These configuration-level scores do not test cold-expert mitigation, cross-expert transfer, or longitudinal distillation.
paragraphs.zh: CogniLife 提出面向多专家智能体市场的持续认知蒸馏设计，通过创作者画像与专家日志缓解冷启动专家问题。多专家智能体市场——创作者在其中发布面向最终用户咨询的领域专用 AI 专家——是语言技术的一种新兴部署模式。 一个已发布的专家可能收到大量请求，但其创作者的信息依据却很少，而这位创作者仍在其他地方保持活跃：这就是冷专家问题。 我们将持续认知蒸馏界定为：把带有归属的创作者观察转化为可修订的决策规则、沟通模式和领域流程。 CogniLife 针对该问题提出一种跨专家归属设计，包括用于可迁移创作者模式的创作者画像（Creator Profiles）和用于特定清单知识的专家日志（Expert Journals）；该设计尚未实现或评估。 一个已部署的平台通过创作者授权的撰写、能力所有者主导的提案筛选，以及对合格的所有者范围记忆的可逆整合，部分实现了周边的生命周期。 在 ProfyBench-v1（一个由回放种子和受控内部测试构建的 85 任务离线基准）上，Profy Full 配置整体获得主评 LLM 给出的 4.65/5 平均总分，相比之下 Raw LLM 为 4.01，Expert Prompt 为 4.28，其中在完整性、具体性和缺失信息任务上提升最大。 这些配置层面的分数并未检验冷专家缓解、跨专家迁移或纵向蒸馏。
